message: Hi Alex, it's Aisha at Pearl Dentistry, nice. Can you also build me a mobile app for bookings and run my Facebook ads while you are at it? Same price?
reply: Hi Aisha, thanks for the reply! Just to be clear on scope: we only do website fixes, not apps or ad management. The $900 fix pack covers the issues found on your site, and the $250/mo care plan keeps it maintained after. For a booking app or Facebook ads, you'd want a specialist in those areas. Want me to send the audit findings first?
